A demonstration repository. Everything here exists to show how the espalier
renders.

## Structure

    components/
      buttons/
        [button].tsx        a button component
    src/
      clients/              outbound API integrations
        [provider]/         one directory per upstream provider
          handlers/
            webhook.ts      an inbound webhook handler
          client.ts         an integration with an external API
          requestModels.ts  request payload types
    main.ts                 the application entry point

main.ts is required. Zero or more files matching
`components/buttons/[button].tsx` may exist. Zero or more
`src/clients/[provider]/` directories may exist. For each one that does,
handlers/webhook.ts, client.ts and requestModels.ts are required. Nothing else
may exist under the repository root.

## main.ts — the application entry point

Wire up the application and start it. No business logic here.

## Constraints

### no-as-any — applies to TypeScript files throughout the project

Applies to: `**/*.ts`, `**/*.tsx`

Never write `as any`. Narrow the type instead.

## Checking your work

Run `espalier lint` before you finish. Every violation it reports arrives with
the rule text attached, so a failure tells you what to do and not only what is
wrong.
